Redline round 2

Reviewed only the fix diff from round 1 (c0ed05b..2b737ed).

The round 1 fixes hold up. `run check` now counts a run's own folders from its launch stamp and snapshot path (checked by running the jq program on sample paths), refuses a hand commit after any stop other than an error, and carries a label's earlier hand list into a second resume. The skill asks about the stopped run before settling any settings, and a non-resumable error clears the stale marker. One problem remains, in the new Finish-comment resume clause: it asks the GitHub agent for a comment URL that `pr-comments` does not print, and never says what to report as `posted`. A resumed handoff can therefore be reported as not posted when it is already on the PR.

### Findings (1 correctness, 0 nit)

- **R2-1** · correctness · low · likely · `workflows/redline-loop.js:392` · The Finish comment resume clause asks for a URL pr-comments cannot give and leaves posted unset

Each finding has an inline comment with the detail or, where GitHub could not anchor it, sits under Not placed inline below. Redline replies in the finding's thread, or in a PR comment that opens with its marker, once the round's fixes are committed.

comments.body:
**R2-1** · correctness · low · likely

**The Finish comment resume clause asks for a URL pr-comments cannot give and leaves posted unset**

On a resume at `handoff comment`, `cap-hit comment` or `summary comment`, the new clause tells the GitHub agent to run `redline-gh.sh pr-comments <pr>`. When it finds the body there, the agent is to "post nothing, return that comment's URL". But `pr-comments` is `gh pr view <pr> --comments`, which prints author, association, edited, status and body for each comment, and no URL or id. Running it on #59 shows this. The GitHub role may not call `gh` directly, so it cannot get the URL, and the clause also does not say what `posted` should be.

An agent following "post nothing" will most likely return `posted: false` with an empty or made-up `comment_url`. The workflow passes `finished.posted` straight into the result as `handoffPosted` (redline-loop.js 2906-2946), `capCommentPosted` and `humanReview.summaryPosted`. So the case this clause exists for (the comment posted, then request-review failed) ends in a `done` result that says the handoff comment was not posted, although it is on the PR. The skill's `done` section then tells the person exactly that. An agent that treats the missing URL as a failure can instead set `error`, and the resume stops at the same label again.

Proposed fix: Make the clause match what the script can show. For example: "... an earlier attempt posted it, so post nothing, set posted true and comment_url to \"\", and go on to Step 3." Then update `commentClause` in tests/loop-test.mjs to match. Optionally add a loop-test check that a resumed handoff whose mock returns `posted: true` with an empty `comment_url` yields `handoffPosted: true`.
